item.title: Immigration union wants sears fired over ignored grievances
item.description: THE head of the union representing customs and immigration officers has called for Immigration Minister Alfred Sears to be fired, accusing him of ignoring months of complaints over promotions, pay and insurance.

item.title: Heroic worker tackles armed man in brazen robbery
item.description: AN heroic kitchen worker tackled a man armed with a hand-held machine gun during a brazen restaurant robbery in which three British ex-pats had a $20,000 Rolex and a $2,000 gold ring stolen.

item.title: Deal blasts business licence process, promises reform
item.description: FREE National Movement candidate for Free Town Lincoln Deal II has criticised the government’s business licence renewal process, saying it is burdening entrepreneurs with unclear requirements, prepayments and audit mandates.

item.title: Court denies daughter control of parents’ affairs
item.description: A SUPREME Court judge has dismissed a daughter’s seven-year bid to take legal control of her elderly parents’ affairs, ruling that the Mental Health Act cannot be used as a vehicle to settle a bitter family dispute over property and control.

item.title: Two men killed in Eleuthera shooting
item.description: A WAITER out on bail for murder and a roofing worker three weeks into a two-month job were shot dead outside a Harbour Island bar shortly after midnight yesterday.

item.title: Man charged for GB bomb threat
item.description: A 32-YEAR-OLD Grand Bahama man was arraigned Monday over a bomb threat that led to an emergency shutdown of the Grand Bahama Power Company’s generation plant and prompted the GBPC to turn off power island wide.

item.title: Concord Wilshire shoots down ‘dead deal’ rumours
item.description: The Government yesterday teamed with the Grand Lucayan’s purchaser to vigorously assert the deal remains “on track” through plans to develop “two major cruise line resorts” and unveil a demolition and construction start date “within the next two weeks”.

item.title: Man accused of posing as female attorney arraigned on 51 charges
item.description: A 30-year-old man who police say posed as a female legal professional while misrepresenting himself as a qualified attorney is to be arraigned in the Magistrate’s Court in Freeport today on multiple fraud and forgery charges.

item.title: Dames distances self from US arrest
item.description: Free National Movement candidate for Mount Moriah Marvin H. Dames has moved to distance himself and his wife from a US criminal investigation involving a business associate.
